mapper.insert: INSERT INTO analysis_data (analysis_batch_date, analysis_date, subbarcode, product_bio, product_id, drive_status, drive_executed_by, drive_executed_at, create_by, create_time, del_flag) SELECT #{row.analysisBatchDate}, #{row.analysisDate}, #{row.subbarcode}, #{row.productBio}, #{row.productId}, #{row.driveStatus}, #{row.operatorName}, NOW(), #{row.createBy}, NOW(), '0' FROM DUAL WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM analysis_data WHERE analysis_batch_date = #{row.analysisBatchDate} AND product_bio = #{row.productBio} AND subbarcode = #{row.subbarcode})

INSERT INTO analysis_data (analysis_batch_date, analysis_date, subbarcode, product_bio, product_id, drive_status, drive_executed_by, drive_executed_at, create_by, create_time, del_flag) VALUES (#{row.analysisBatchDate}, #{row.analysisDate}, #{row.subbarcode}, #{row.productBio}, #{row.productId}, #{row.driveStatus}, #{row.operatorName}, NOW(), #{row.createBy}, NOW(), '0')
mapper.select: SELECT analysis_batch_date AS analysisBatchDate, analysis_date AS analysisDate, product_bio AS productBio, subbarcode AS subbarcode FROM analysis_data WHERE analysis_id = #{analysisId} AND del_flag = '0' LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM analysis_data WHERE analysis_id = #{analysisId} AND del_flag = '0'
mapper.update: UPDATE analysis_data SET drive_status = #{driveStatus}, drive_executed_by = #{executedBy}, drive_executed_at = NOW(), update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = NOW() WHERE analysis_id = #{analysisId}
